name: CaseGridOnComponentVariant
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-on-component-variant" (grid-composition). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: layoutMode GRID on a COMPONENT node (canvas variants are components)
